title: Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts Schedule of Benefits — Appliance and Garage Door Opener Limits
content:
This schedule sets, for Homeowner Service Contracts, the per-term limit for each covered appliance and for the garage door opener. Figures are US dollars per term; 0.00 means the item is not covered by the tier.

| | ApplianceCare | SystemsCare | HomeCare Bronze | HomeCare Silver | HomeCare Gold | HomeCare Platinum |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kitchen refrigerator | 2000.00 | 0.00 | 1500.00 | 2000.00 | 2500.00 | 3500.00 |
| Oven, range and cooktop | 1500.00 | 0.00 | 1000.00 | 1500.00 | 2000.00 | 3000.00 |
| Dishwasher | 1000.00 | 0.00 | 750.00 | 1000.00 | 1500.00 | 2000.00 |
| Built-in microwave | 750.00 | 0.00 | 500.00 | 750.00 | 1000.00 | 1500.00 |
| Clothes washer | 1200.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 1200.00 | 1500.00 | 2000.00 |
| Clothes dryer | 1200.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 1200.00 | 1500.00 | 2000.00 |
| Garage door opener | 500.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 500.00 | 750.00 | 1000.00 |

### Points read directly from the table

- Bridgewell SystemsCare covers none of the items in this schedule: every row reads 0.00 in its column.
- Bridgewell HomeCare Bronze covers the kitchen appliances (refrigerator, oven range and cooktop, dishwasher, built-in microwave) but not the clothes washer, clothes dryer or garage door opener.
- Bridgewell ApplianceCare and Bridgewell HomeCare Silver carry identical figures on every row of this schedule.
- Each figure is a per-item, per-term limit for that one item; the aggregate term limit for the contract appears on the systems schedule of benefits.
